agent_context: Agent on FastBusiness ERP. Code = XML controllers on UNC paths; data = SQL Server. MCP tools available.

task_type_catalog.read_summary: SAFE DEFAULT first read of ONE known file: summary map for XML controllers in Dir/Grid/Filter (JS funcs, SQL objects, fields); auto-falls back to raw for other files (.sql/.js/Templates/Report)
task_type_catalog.read_flat: Read FULL expanded content of one known XML file (entities resolved) to see every line
task_type_catalog.read_raw: Read raw content of one known file untouched - non-controller files (.sql/.js/.ent/.aspx) or XML not directly under Dir/Grid/Filter (Templates, Report)
task_type_catalog.read_snippet: Extract ONE specific block from a known file: a JS function, SQL command/action, field, or line range
task_type_catalog.read_suggest_edit: Before editing a file: locate region and get exact old_string + diff_preview for str_replace
task_type_catalog.grep_content: Find WHICH files contain a string/keyword inside file content (grep). Target files unknown
task_type_catalog.find_definition: Find WHERE a JS symbol/function is defined
task_type_catalog.find_references: List ALL usage sites of a symbol for rename/refactor
task_type_catalog.match_filename: List files matching a NAME/glob only - does not read content
task_type_catalog.diff_folder: Compare TWO folders/projects - what is missing or different
task_type_catalog.list_folder: List files in ONE folder (like ls/dir), no compare
task_type_catalog.diff_xml: Compare XML controllers between two projects by relative path or keyword seed
task_type_catalog.diff_sql_table: Compare SQL objects or table schemas between two project databases
task_type_catalog.clone_sql: Copy missing SQL objects (proc/func/view/table) from source project to target project -> one .sql file
task_type_catalog.paste_sql: Export a SQL object body out to a .sql file (ALTER) or analyze it, to edit manually
task_type_catalog.clone_data: Export table ROWS matching a where into DELETE+INSERT .sql script
task_type_catalog.copy_files: Copy/rename files or a whole controller set (suite) between or within projects
task_type_catalog.db_object: Inspect ONE DB object: table schema (CREATE TABLE) or proc/view/func summary - knows the object name
task_type_catalog.db_snippet: Extract code blocks of a known proc by keywords/zones
task_type_catalog.db_run_sql: Run a short inline SELECT/SQL statement
task_type_catalog.db_check_syntax: PARSEONLY syntax-check a .sql file before deploy - does not execute
task_type_catalog.db_search: Search DB objects by name LIKE or by references ('which proc uses table/field X')
task_type_catalog.entity_content: View the CONTENT of named DOCTYPE entities in an XML file
task_type_catalog.entity_list: List all entities declared in an XML file
task_type_catalog.entity_check: Lint XML: undeclared &entity; used or SYSTEM entity pointing to missing files
task_type_catalog.graph_query: Query the XML controller graph (Kuzu): which controller calls/retrieves/uses a lookup, table or file; master-detail relations, neighbors, clusters - via fixed Cypher templates
task_type_catalog.ur_semantic: Semantic search of past user requests/tickets by description
task_type_catalog.ur_exact: Fetch exact ticket(s) by fcode1 (YC number) or ma_da (project code) - bypass semantic
task_type_catalog.no_match: None of the above fits this step

task_requirement: Tạo mới danh mục 'Cập nhật tất toán TD,CD': Ngày bán; Mã TD,CD lookup danh mục khế ước; Số lượng; Giá bán; Giá trị bán; Tiền gốc thu về; Tiền lãi thu về; Tiền lãi dồn tích thu về; Tổng thu về. Tất cả tự nhập, có import. Khóa chính tự tăng theo cột ID, không check trùng.
steps: Tra lịch sử UR xem đã từng làm danh mục tất toán TD,CD hay tương tự chưa
Tìm cặp file Dir/Grid của danh mục khế ước hoặc danh mục tương tự trong dự án để làm mẫu
Đọc summary 2 file Dir/Grid mẫu vừa tìm được để xem cấu trúc field, lookup, import
Clone cặp Dir/Grid mẫu sang tên controller danh mục mới
Kiểm tra file XML vừa clone có entity nào thiếu/chưa khai báo
Check syntax file .sql tạo bảng danh mục + PK trước khi đưa user chạy
Đăng ký danh mục mới lên menu Quỹ đầu tư > Tiền gửi ngân hàng
